usedFor: Process Street runs checklists, and Dropbox saves a file through “Upload File to Dropbox” after a “Workflow Run Completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Run Completed” in Process Street, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: A finished run saves a file from a public web link into a chosen Dropbox folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public link and a choice for existing files, so decide that first.
